headline: Action Continues at LinnMercy, Mooring County and Stonecradle
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the heaviest strongpoint traffic has stayed put: LinnMercy, Mooring County and Stonecradle are the only regions showing events in the latest two-hour window. LinnMercy and Mooring County each logged six, Stonecradle three. Lathair, Wiccwalk and World's End remain the busiest named bases on those fronts. Stlican Shelf still carries a heavy twenty-four-hour list of twenty-five events but has gone quiet in the final two-hour sheet, its last return coming near 19:18. Fisherman's Row remains the day's highest total with thirty-nine events, though it is quiet by the same recent measure; Weathered Expanse has slipped to thirty-two on the rolling day and shows no two-hour action. Farranac Coast added three six-hour events but no two-hour action. Callahan's Passage, hot in the earlier casualty returns, has cooled sharply. Casualty rates stay high on the active central fronts, and the ownership board shows no winner yet, with neither side at the required thirty-four victory towns.
